workspace.title: How It Works
lines: Set one workspace root here for every FileManage operation.
The operation pages preview what will happen inside this root before you run anything.
You can still tune each tool separately from its own settings page.

rename.title: Rename Workflows
lines: Text Transform replaces text, adds prefixes or suffixes, removes matched text, and still supports per-folder alphabet mode.
Trim by Delimiter keeps or removes the part of a filename around a delimiter like _, -, (, or [.
Numbering can swap existing number blocks or add a numbered prefix or suffix before you run the preview.

extension.title: Extension Workflow
lines: Use the Source Extension dropdown to convert one image type only, or choose .all to include every supported image type in the workspace.
The conversion run writes a new file in the selected target extension and removes the old file only after the save succeeds.

zip.title: Archive Notes
lines: Each ZIP archive is expanded into a folder with the same base name.
You can keep the source ZIP files or delete them after extraction completes.

images-to-pdf.title: PDF Build Notes
lines: Folders with matching images become PDF outputs named after that folder.
The fit options let you scale or pad images to match the largest page size in the set.

pdf-to-images.title: PDF Export Notes
lines: Each PDF becomes a sibling folder named after the source file.
The page images are written in order so the preview page stays aligned with the run result.

webp-to-mp4.title: Video Conversion Notes
lines: The current FileManage workspace acts as the source root for all .webp files.
Converted MP4 files are written under the output root while mirroring the workspace folder structure.
Animated WebP files are rebuilt from frames so their timing stays close to the original source.
